comment: One activation at A. B is granted (auto); C holds no grant (refused, default-deny, checked at every gate a token reaches, SPEC §5.1/§7.1). D's effective verdict is the join of its own auto, B's effective auto, and C's effective refused -> refused; the master withholds. B and C are mutually incomparable in the pipe relation, so the declaration-order tie-break (SPEC §7.4) is the only thing that fixes the log: B is declared before C, so the log runs A, B, C, D.
